gaps: Partial regional history; Laurel, Maxima, Vanette export badge periods require further boundaries; Cablight still awaits verification.
No claim of current Czech or European type approval for revived Indian/Russian/Indonesian Datsuns.
Most historic production bounds, exact engine/gearbox combinations and facelifts remain null.
Small prewar light-commercial families are grouped rather than one speculative card per export badge.
Photos searched partially; null is not a claim that Commons is exhausted.
excluded: DAT brand before Datsun is not silently counted as Datsun production.
Datsun Baby amusement-park vehicle, concepts and race-only versions excluded.
Unverified Nissan-only late generations not duplicated.
